extensions.name: Reading time
extensions.blurb: Adds an estimated reading time above each post.

extensions.name: Heading anchors
extensions.blurb: Gives every heading a stable id and a # link, so a section can be linked to.

extensions.name: Table of contents
extensions.blurb: Adds a contents list of the h2 and h3 headings to a post that has three or more.

extensions.name: Smart typography
extensions.blurb: Curly quotes, dashes and ellipses in the rendered post. Code, links and URLs are left alone; the markdown source is never changed.

extensions.name: Archive by year
extensions.blurb: Groups the post list under a heading for each year. Needs dates shown in the list; uses the blog-webcli-v1 markup.

extensions.name: Image captions
extensions.blurb: Shows an image's alt text as a visible caption (a figure with a figcaption). Uses the blog-webcli-v1 markup.
